events.line: Adam, I didn't know you were allowed to just *cheat* like this—Drake Maye absolutely obliterated that projection and made your entire roster look competent for once, which is honestly shocking given your draft history.

Arben actually pulled off a miracle by starting Warren and watching him explode for 33.8 when everyone thought he'd be a dud at 15.9—too bad your entire season's still circling the drain because you've made worse decisions than this one good call.

Nori actually had the balls to start Watson and watched him go absolutely nuclear for 29.3 points—congrats on the accidental masterstroke, you absolute donkey, because we both know you were sweating bullets with that projection at halftime.

Faton, starting a backup QB who wasn't even in the damn league two weeks ago and getting negative points is the most Faton shit I've ever seen—at least you're consistent with your terrible decision-making.

Bucky Irving just shit all over his projection and Rinor's probably still wondering how he accidentally made the right call—30.5 points from a guy he was clearly banking on to bust, and somehow the fantasy gods decided to bless this mess anyway.

Isaiah Likely just went absolutely nuclear and you still managed to look like a genius by accident—that's what happens when you start a TE as a desperation play and he decides to drop 26.9 on your ass, Flamur.
Adam really said "nah, I don't trust this guy" and threw 16 points on the bench like it was nothing—what the fuck were you doing, leaving nearly a touchdown on the sideline?

Faton, Parker Washington just absolutely nuked his projection and you still managed to look like a genius by accident—maybe next week try actually watching tape instead of just throwing darts at the waiver wire blindfolded.

Faton, you absolute moron—Dobbins went off for 14.4 points on your bench while you were probably starting some waiver-wire dart throw instead, and now you're sitting here watching your season implode because you can't trust your own fucking roster.
Flamur, CeeDee showing up with 1.9 points after you projected 15.5 is like ordering a steak and getting a fucking napkin -- and the worst part is you *knew* it was coming and started him anyway.
